## Design

### 2026-10-13 – Today was a shorter work session than I hoped, but I did get most of the Starbie case done!

**0.78h**

Today was a shorter work session than I hoped, but I did get most of the Starbie case done!

I started off by exporting my PCB from KiCad and importing it into Onshape.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 212128](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/17521cbe52027f402b98d37b8962cd9ea6581a9682c0d524c45ce6c4316407a0.png)

I used this both to copy the outline of the PCB for a snug fit and to figure out how thick I would need my enclosure to be to fit all my components. I'm fairly sure my DHT11 will be the tallest component on my PCB. I think I'll put it on the bottom of my PCB; if they're on the same side I'll either have a stupid sensor sticking out of my enclosure or you'll have to reach an inch into the enclosure to hit the Starbie's buttons.

I messed around with the dimensions a bit, then I added some nice fillets and added a keychain hole.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 212059](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/dd5c7ad8985e62f51b23982a5bdbc36c877f3dc77139eeecc410b02837b05f4e.png)

This was my stopping point for the day. Tomorrow I'm going to add some tabs to keep the PCB vertically in place and add a screen cutout.

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/ec737397-dab6-4dca-a8ca-6a2d4c5383e5/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-15 – Today I made a lot of progress. I finished the starbie case, made the mouse case and made the crochet supplies drawer thingy.

**1.58h**

Today I made a lot of progress. I finished the starbie case, made the mouse case and made the crochet supplies drawer thingy.

I started off by adding tabs to my starbie case to hold it together. I also split it in half so I can pop the halves together after it's printed and use glue to get the PCB real snug.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 204729](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/b43f4e61ff6a68ab9398ceff1b1258f9173f537bda248486c828df6c9ea3f515.png)

Then I made the mouse case. It's a pretty simple design that I may or may not have stolen the idea for from my friend: the lid is kinda like a cork, you do a close fit so it takes a bit of effort to slide it off. It also has a key ring so I can attach my starbie!

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 204628](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/308d8437d1d623c1b38508682d9922a82f11c6ca31a89cf21e7f5c6ed24ad689.png)

Finally, I made the drawer for my crochet supplies. The big compartment is for my hooks and scissors, the smaller compartment is for my measuring tape and the mini compartment is for my stitch markers! I didn't do any tracks for the drawer for the sake of simplicity, but I might end up adding them later if I have extra time.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 204655](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/a1e2296ed75d61c5c1e242167188cfc4b5c81431e37bb9a5d507d735c0022aed.png)

The drawer case is going to have slots for the modular aspect: each piece is going to have its place to slide on or off!

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 205326](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/abeef00ae6b02fa9d0545ded78694c70396c65170b3546ba5c9bd133218d2160.png)
^The slots for my mouse case. You can find matching ones above on the mouse case image.

Tomorrow it's time for my pencil/planner/sticky note holder!!

[Timelapse](https://lookout.hackclub.com/api/media/511c57ef-3929-40bd-9b8d-fc4f36aec6a8/video.mp4)

### 2026-10-16 – Today was pencil case day.

**2.13h**

Today was pencil case day.

I started out by measuring everything I wanted the case to hold (calculator, planner, pencils, stickies, paperclips) and mapping it out.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 143501](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/79070cf621ed6bb4490e352fa72020e98e6d2dafe9904750d08d6be1f8d65a73.png)

I wanted to keep going with the star theme, so I took some inspo from wired pencil holders and made this star pattern that was originally supposed to end up looking like a wire pattern but didnt end up doing that but it's whatever.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 145120](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/59cfd4bfaeaa3c77dc76666c4f11465be929b434b6e545e3c495ed027ba91cc9.png)
^Pain and suffering.

After I finished my pencil case, I completed what was the most important part by far of this project:

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 172248](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/095bea61eccda46ecbe0ccd5255ce0fac5526d4fd209fd1a5a58594ceb05a0ee.png)
lol

Tomorrow I'll make my final 2 components: a lockable phone jail and a headphone holder. Then I'll run stuff through my slicer to figure out how much filament to put in my BoM.
